mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, order_state from user_raffle_order where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and order_state = 'create' and raffle_type = #{raffleType} order by create_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update user_raffle_order set order_state='used',update_time=now() where user_id=#{userId} and order_id=#{orderId} and order_state='create'
